question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84e22d5707c870d11a4e2a1b8bad2bd43950935a8e3f7542b0758002436b5f8a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Inner part of all the shape is shifting inside the another shape in a clockwise direction.

Two shapes are shifting their position in clockwise direction and two shapes remain same.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92c1d28de2ce9e7f02fbea620d07ea9d7c1ca87f5a9520745a3f25f7be9865c4.png]
